summary_en: 8.3M shares (8.88% of S/O), ¥40.0B upper limit, ¥4,819/share ceiling implied, ToSTNeT-3 and open-market methods, Sep 1-18, 2026. Acquired shares intended for cancellation pending board review of execution results.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Acquisition of Own Shares (Acquisition of treasury shares under Articles of Incorporation pursuant to Article 165(2) of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: NIFCO announced on 31 August 2026 that its board resolved to acquire up to 8.3 million of its own shares (8.88% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for up to ¥40.0 billion. The purchase window runs 1–18 September 2026 via two methods: ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange block execution) and open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under discretionary investment authority. The stated rationale is shareholder return and capital-efficiency improvement. The company intends to cancel the acquired shares but will confirm cancellation only after reviewing execution results; cancellation details including the number of shares and effective date will be announced separately. As of 31 July 2026, NIFCO held 6.85 million treasury shares against 93.38 million shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
